_help: One entry per map symbol. solid = blocks movement. colour = [red, green, blue], used when there is no image. image = optional 32x32 PNG inside the assets folder, e.g. "tiles/wall.png". speed = optional multiplier for how fast cars can go on it (1 = normal, 0.5 = half). S, M and the digits are reserved for the start, the machine and parts; they stand on a '.' floor tile.
